mentions.name: RGBloom
mentions.description: This service lets users create printed photo books in minutes, delivered in the UK for £10 including delivery. It offers a web app plus iOS and Android apps, is privacy-first (no accounts required, optional email wiped after 30 days, minimal data retained for as short a time as possible), and uses transparent pricing with no surprise delivery fees or discounts.
mentions.problem: Photo book services typically require accounts, hold onto personal data, and hit customers with large delivery fees at checkout instead of honest pricing.
mentions.audience: Consumers in the UK (UK only for now)
mentions.source_excerpt: RGBloom: create printed photo books in minutes (UK only for now) for just £10 including delivery. Been working on this for 8 months, recently launched iOS and Android apps to go alongside the web app.
mentions.author: jakegmaths
